name: cpp-conventions
description: Evidence-backed C++ conventions as five skills - designated-init (one braced expression per value), no-needless-copies (views, sinks, ownership boundaries), cppreference (confirm a rule and cite the page, cached offline), units (std::chrono and mp-units quantities, one wall clock) and no-magic-numbers (name every number once) - with compiler fixtures for GCC and Clang and an advisory pre-write hook that scans new C++ text for copy smells and bare numbers.
